results.name: partial draft saves explicitly, reload needs restore, removal keeps open draft
desk displays actual objective/output/stop and editable local next-action notes
full-plan download contains exact planning notes and brief; save repeated click writes once
optional backend check sends exactly six fields, never local notes or saved metadata
unsaved edits do not overwrite snapshot; restore cancel and confirm are explicit
restore interrupts pending validation; stale response cannot validate restored work
reload keeps content undisclosed until restore and never restores server verification
storage change in another tab does not replace this open draft
desktop/mobile desk, saved banner and restore/reset dialogs pass accessibility
reset clears current plan; saved copy survives until explicit removal
corrupt, oversized, unsupported-version and injected snapshots cannot restore or execute
quota and removal failures are visible without dropping the current draft
